artworks.title: Nocturne
artworks.medium: lithotint in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line, featuring dark, vague shapes of buildings or structures in the distance against a misty backdrop. Above the horizon are chimneys and a dome-like architectural feature, suggesting an industrial or urban environment. The soft brushstrokes create a dreamy atmosphere, with blurred edges. The color palette is muted, primarily gray, enhancing a tranquil and somber mood. Near the forefront, there is a solitary figure on a small boat or craft, barely visible.

artworks.title: The Toilet
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person standing in profile while looking at something in their hands. The person is wearing a long dress and has neatly arranged hair. The background is a simple dark and soft gray shading.

artworks.title: The Toilet
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a full-body side profile view. She is facing away from the viewer, holding an open fan with her arms bent at the elbows. Her hair is styled up, showing her neck, and she is wearing a long dress that appears elaborate with layers or ruffles. The background is textured and shaded without any clear objects or settings.

artworks.title: Early Morning
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene from an elevated perspective, with a wide expanse of water in view. The horizon is high in the composition, with faint outlines of buildings and structures interrupting the skyline. The brushstrokes are delicate and loose, creating a sense of softness and blending the elements in the scene. The color palette is limited to sepia and soft gray tones. Two figures are barely discernible near the viewer, adding a sense of scale and human presence to the waterscape.

artworks.title: The Broad Bridge
artworks.medium: lithotint in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a small rowboat with a single figure, surrounded by a large wooden bridge structure. In the distance, a silhouette of a bridge and urban landscape is visible. The artwork is sketch-like, with pencil strokes creating texture and depth, while shading adds contrast. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily brown and beige.

artworks.title: The Tall Bridge
artworks.medium: lithotint in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an arched bridge structure viewed from below. The horizon is low and hidden by the bridge pilings that frame the scene. Additional structures and masts are faintly visible beyond the bridge. The brushstrokes are sketch-like and in a brown sepia tone, creating a rustic effect. The image consists of varying shades of sepia, emphasizing the water's reflective surface.

artworks.title: Gaiety Stage Door
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene with people and a horse-drawn carriage. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing the activity of the scene. The focus is on a group near the entrance of a building slightly towards the left. The brushstrokes are sparse and delicate, with sketch-like qualities. The color palette consists of black and white. Figures are positioned near the building's entrance, with a seated figure on the left. In the background, a horse and carriage are visible, suggesting motion.

artworks.title: Victoria Club
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an urban scene with a street view of a classical architectural facade. The horizon is suggested by the line where the building meets the ground. The architecture features arched windows and decorative elements. The drawing depicts figures and architectural details with loose, sketchy lines to convey movement and activity. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of charcoal or graphite against a light background. People are shown walking or standing, sketched in a way that suggests motion, adding to the lively urban atmosphere.

artworks.title: Old Battersea Bridge
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from below a bridge, looking up at it. The horizon is blocked by the bridge's structure, with faint outlines of buildings or structures in the distance. The sketch features precise line work, resembling architectural or impressionistic styles. The color scheme is monochrome, using shades of black and beige. Figures on the bridge are depicted engaged in various activities, and urban structures are hinted at beyond the bridge.

artworks.title: Reading
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch features a person sitting in a slightly hunched position. The outline shows the full body, and the individual seems focused on something in their hands. The face is not detailed, and the hair is styled or pulled back. The person wears a long-sleeved gown or dress that reaches the floor with fabric folds indicated by lines. No jewelry or accessories are visible. The background is plain, emphasizing the individual through shading techniques in the monochromatic drawing.

artworks.title: Reading
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features multiple sketches of women in various poses and outfits. The central figure is seated with a relaxed posture, undefined facial features, and voluminous hair. She wears a dress with textured folds and layers. Additional sketches show women in seated positions, one holding a round object that resembles a fan, all with indistinct facial features and outfits with collars or trims. The background consists of cross-hatched and shaded areas.

artworks.title: Entrance Gate
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a pencil sketch viewed head-on, with a tall structure and ornate entrance as the central focus. The horizon is not distinctly identifiable. The lines are delicate and lightly applied, giving the sketch a tentative and ethereal quality. The color palette is monochromatic, relying solely on the contrast between the soft grey pencil lines and the cream paper. Various architectural details create interest beyond the main structure, with small, indistinct figures depicted closest to us. The composition conveys a sense of elegant simplicity, with ample negative space around the sketched elements.

artworks.title: Churchyard
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban scene with a row of two-story buildings. The perspective is frontal, showing architectural details like windows and doorways. The sketch uses a monochromatic palette of soft gray tones on a cream background created with fine pencil strokes, giving an impressionistic feel. Details in the foreground are more pronounced, while the background is depicted with less definition, suggesting depth.Urban life is subtly suggested within shaded areas.

artworks.title: Little Court, Cloth Fair
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a view from street level of an urban alley or street lined with buildings. The horizon line is obscured by the angular shapes and rooflines of the buildings. The drawing is executed in a loose, gestural style with quick pencil strokes. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray on white paper. Closest to us, there is a suggestion of cobblestone or paving detail leading the eye into the scene, where a small group of figures is gathered. In the background, there are faint indications of distant architecture blending into the paper.

artworks.title: Lindsay Row, Chelsea
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This image shows a sketch of a house with a rooftop, chimney, and a fence extending horizontally across the scene. The drawing uses a pencil technique with loose strokes to outline the architecture and vegetation. The color palette is limited to shades of gray against a cream background. A tree frames the building in the foreground, while faint lines suggest additional elements in the distance.

artworks.title: Chelsea Shops
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal urban scene featuring the facade of a building. The horizon line is not explicitly defined. The architectural elevation of the building is the main focus. There are no clear elements on the horizon line. The technique involves delicate pencil strokes, creating an impressionistic style. The color palette is monochromatic gray. In the foreground, a figure is on the left, and two figures are near the right in front of a window. In the distance, the structure's details are suggested with faintly drawn windows. The overall presentation is minimalist with sparse lines defining the scene.

artworks.title: Drury Lane Rags
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a storefront. The image features a simple outline sketch of a building facade. The window displays various forms that give the impression of goods inside. On either side of the entrance, there are figures sketched with minimal detail. The drawing is composed with light pencil strokes, giving it an airy appearance. The lines are delicate and suggestive, focusing on concept rather than precise representation.

artworks.title: Drury Lane Rags
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a storefront from an elevated viewpoint, focusing on the front of a building. The background is minimally depicted, with a few architectural details suggesting a street. The lines are precise and minimal, with a soft color palette dominated by yellows, blues, and greys. Figures, including a child and adults, are near the entrance. In the distance, other buildings are faintly outlined. The background is simple, emphasizing the storefront and figures.

artworks.title: Chelsea Rags
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an urban scene with a storefront. The scene includes a shop with items displayed outside, steps leading to an entrance, large windows, and figures in front of the shop. The drawing is done in a sketchy, impressionistic style with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Courtyard, Chelsea Hospital
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural facade with figures in front of it. The base of the building suggests a horizon, with no other major elements along it. The artwork features delicate pencil strokes, creating a sketch-like quality with light shading and line work. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray against beige. Some loosely sketched figures are near the viewer, while the building in the background has a detailed doorway, surrounded by windows and architectural ornamentation.

artworks.title: The Farriers
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a person standing next to a horse. The person is upright, facing slightly to the side, with one hand resting on the horse's back. The facial features of the person are detailed, with a serene expression and short, smooth hair. The person wears a loose garment that reaches the ankles, without any visible jewelry or objects in hand. The background shows a lightly shaded, sketch-like barn environment with an impressionistic style. The sketch is done in pencil or graphite with shading for depth and form.

artworks.title: The Winged Hat
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a seated woman from her head to her lower legs. She is sitting with her body slightly turned to the left, resting her right arm on her lap. Her left arm is not clearly outlined. Her facial features are softly rendered with closed eyes or a relaxed expression, and she wears a wide-brimmed hat with a feather decoration. She appears to have short, tucked hair beneath the hat. She is wearing a formal dress with a high collar and possibly details like ruffles. There is no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background of the sketch is plain, with no specific details or scenery drawn. The sketch is done in a minimalist style with light and dark shading to suggest form and depth.

artworks.title: Gants de Suède
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body pencil sketch of a woman standing in a graceful pose. She is depicted with arms extended downward, hands relaxed, delicate facial features, and styled hair partly covered by a large brimmed hat with a decorative element. She wears a long dress with puffed sleeves and detailed fabric lines. The background is a plain, textured surface with minimal shading outlining her figure and suggesting a shadow. No specific details on jewelry or objects are included.

artworks.title: The Tyresmith
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an interior drawing of a blacksmith shop. The sketch shows the workshop with workers and equipment, along with decorations on the walls. The composition guides the eye through an open passage, portraying a sense of activity and depth in the space.
